root_selection: Inspect every consecutive six-pivot start. Execute first and last eligible starts per region per geometry width; retain all excluded/unvisited starts. No result-based selection.

macro_reassessment.selection: Original discovery member with minimum LOW / maximum HIGH in each predeclared historical visual region; latest timestamp for ties. Missing member or nonalternating movements yield a recorded unavailable proposal, not fabricated pivots.
macro_reassessment.authority: Prior visual regions are analyst hypotheses only. Skipping geometric pivots is declared operational scope selection, never wave significance or endpoint proof.

expansion: Macro roots only; roles 1,3,5 on Weekly. Thereafter last chronological selected child proposal, role 5 only, through the explicit resolution sequence. First and last eligible consecutive scopes retained as separate alternatives. Never select by P004/P005. Stop descendants of exact P004-rejected hypotheses; record them, do not substitute another candidate.
binding: Exact existing Normal Impulse role child subject is the child candidate request subject. Existing Kernel recursive composition aggregates the selected child result as a caller-supplied partial structure. This is not a new source-derived family requirement or family certificate.
coverage: Strict parent pivot timestamp interval. Finer bars outside it are excluded; no endpoint equality, bar-boundary extension, or full-window completion is invented. Missing prefix/suffix history stays explicit.
cache: Reuse identical observation/config/window discovery objects; never reuse evaluated candidates across foreign subjects, roles, or snapshots. Cached objects are revalidated by existing factories.
recent_reassessment: Reconcile prior A/B/L1/L2 regions separately as interpretive nodes. They cannot become executable operands unless an original geometric member and genuine public binding exist. No extra capture.
omissions: Skipped-pivot combinatorics outside declared macro regions
relative_degree: Caller-proposed parent/child relation only; traversal depth is not a named Elliott degree
